The '''Kliap sector''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]],<ref name="EAOC" /> bordering the [[Barma sector/Legends|Barma sector]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 1}}</ref> It contained the [[Vasuuli system/Legends|Vasuuli system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was the site of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Vasuuli relay station]]|system=Vasuuli [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Vasuuli relay station]], a communications center operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Wizards" />

The Rebel [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] center located on Barma [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[AX-456]] linked up with similar comm centers in the adjacent Kliap and [[Haldeen sector/Legends|Haldeen sectors]]. When AX-456 was [[Battle of AX-456|assaulted]] by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Wizards" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="1 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', which include the [[Battle of AX-456|assault]] on [[AX-456]], to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> the Rebellion scrambled a strike team from the Vasuuli [[Relay station/Legends|relay station]] and dispatched it to the asteroid.<ref name="Wizards" />

At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the pair of [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] known as the [[Venithon Twins]] worked for the [[Kliap Pirates]], a notorious pirate gang known for carrying out flashy raids in the Kliap sector.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kliap sector was first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the sector's Vasuuli [[Star system/Legends|system]] in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
